Public Council Agenda and Minutes
The Agendas for Ordinary Council Meetings are normally available for public viewing within 3 days of the Council meeting date. 
The Minutes of Council Meetings are normally available within 5 days after the Council Meeting.  For Council Minute enquiries, please contact Council on 8555 7000.
Council Meeting Audio Recordings
The audio of Council Meetings are recorded and the recordings are published on the website as soon as practicable after the Council Meeting. Please note that the audio files are quite large and may take a while to download.

Public Council Agenda and Minutes
The Agendas for Ordinary Council Meetings are normally available for public viewing within 3 days of the Council meeting date. 
The Minutes of Council Meetings are normally available within 5 days after the Council Meeting.  For Council Minute enquiries, please contact Council on 8555 7000.
Council Meeting Audio Recordings
The audio of Council Meetings are recorded and the recordings are published on the website as soon as practicable after the Council Meeting. Please note that the audio files are quite large and may take a while to download.

Public Council Agenda and Minutes
The Agendas for Ordinary Council Meetings are normally available for public viewing within 3 days of the Council meeting date. 
The Minutes of Council Meetings are normally available within 5 days after the Council Meeting.  For Council Minute enquiries, please contact Council on 8555 7000.
Council Meeting Audio Recordings
The audio of Council Meetings are recorded and the recordings are published on the website as soon as practicable after the Council Meeting. Please note that the audio files are quite large and may take a while to download.

Public Council Agenda and Minutes
The Agendas for Ordinary Council Meetings are normally available for public viewing within 3 days of the Council meeting date. 
The Minutes of Council Meetings are normally available within 5 days after the Council Meeting.  For Council Minute enquiries, please contact Council on 8555 7000.
Council Meeting Audio Recordings
The audio of Council Meetings are recorded and the recordings are published on the website as soon as practicable after the Council Meeting. Please note that the audio files are quite large and may take a while to download.

Please note, as of August 2020 the Council Assessment Panel was replaced by the Fleurieu Regional Assessment Panel.
The Fleurieu Regional Assessment Panel (FRAP) is an independent body that has been established under the Planning, Development and Infrastructure Act 2016.  The FRAP is responsible for considering qualifying Development Applications within Alexandrina Council, the City of Victor Harbor and the District Council of Yankalilla. The Panel consists of the following four (4) members:
Independent Members
  • Stephen Smith (Presiding Member)
  • Cherry Getsom
  • Jamie Botten
  • Jock Smylie
Council Member Representative
  • Cr Bill Coomans (Alexandrina Council)
Deputy Council Member Representative 
  • Cr Simon Rothwell (District Council of Yankalilla)
Non-Sitting Council Representative
  • Cr Carol Schofield (City of Victor Harbor)
Assessment Manager
  • Cameron Gibbons, Manager Development Services, Alexandrina Council
The role of the Fleurieu Regional Assessment Panel is to make decisions on planning applications, as required, in accordance with the relevant Planning policy.  All members have a keen interest in community planning and have sound knowledge of the relevant legislation under which their decision making is guided.  All members have the appropriate qualifications and/or experience required to undertake a development assessment role.
The role of the Assessment Manager is to manage the staff and operations of the Panel and to provide advice to the Panel as appropriate.
Panel meetings are scheduled for the third Tuesday of each month. The venue will be confirmed prior to each meeting and included in the Agenda. Possible locations include:
  • Alexandrina Council Community Chambers 'Wal Yuntu Warrin', 11 Cadell Street , Goolwa
  • City of Victor Harbor Council Chambers, 1 Bay Road, Victor Harbor
  • District Council of Yankalilla Council Chambers, 1 Charles Street, Yankalilla
2026 Meeting Dates and Times
  • 20 January (cancelled)
  • 17 February (cancelled)
  • 17 March
  • 21 April
  • 12 May
  • 23 June (cancelled)
  • 7 July (Special meeting)
  • 21 July
  • 18 August
  • 22 September
  • 20 October
  • 17 November
  • 15 December
Agendas are available at Council libraries and on Council’s website one week prior to the meeting.
All meetings are open to the community.

Pursuant to section 126 of the Local Government Act 1999 (the Act), Alexandrina Council established their Audit and Risk Committee in accordance with Section 41 of the Act on 28 November 2022 (ACM1721).
The Audit and Risk Committee plays a crucial role in enhancing the efficiency and effectiveness of Alexandrina Council's resource utilisation. Our committee provides independent assurance and expert advice to the Council on matters such as accounting, financial management, internal controls, risk management, and governance.
The Committee operates independently from management, offering valuable insights without executive powers. Reports to the Council from Audit and Risk aim to facilitate informed decision-making in alignment with our responsibilities, as outlined in the Terms of Reference.
Membership of the Committee consists of 5 Members, 3 of whom are Independent Members determined by Council to have the experience relevant to the functions of the Committee, 1 Council Member and the Presiding Member of Council as ex-officio. They Council may also wish to appoint a proxy to this committee.
Meetings of Audit and Risk are open to the public unless indicated otherwise.
